import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = (n + 1) / 2;
        PriorityQueue<Integer> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Collections.reverseOrder());
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            pq.add(x);
            if (pq.size() > k) {
                pq.poll();
            }
        }
        System.out.println(pq.peek());
    }
}
